prompt:
Create a looping pixel-art animation of magical light for a top-down 2D fantasy action game.

Image 1 shows an open treasure chest with light shining up out of it. Animate only that light. Draw only the light: leave out the chest itself completely, so where the chest is there is only the background.

The light keeps the same place, size and shape as in Image 1: a few vertical beams that fan out a little as they rise from the opening of the chest, and three or four small four-pointed sparkles around them. It is a gentle, calm shimmer that loops smoothly:
- The beams flicker softly: each beam grows a little taller and shrinks back, out of step with the others, and their brightness pulses.
- The sparkles twinkle one after another: each one appears as a single dot, grows into a four-pointed star, and shrinks back, at slightly different places around the beams.
- The bottom of the beams stays on one line in every frame, where the opening of the chest would be.

Use the same chunky pixel-art style and the same dot size as Image 1. The light is white in the centre and very pale yellow at its edges, drawn with 2 or 3 flat tones in clean clusters of dots. No outline, no soft gradient, no blur, no haze.

Flat solid pure magenta background, RGB 255,0,255, in every frame. No chest, no coins, no ground, no shadow, no text, no border.
